summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader as specified. Changes: monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (load_decathalon_datalist plus private _resolve_path helper, Google-style docstring, fully type-annotated, stdlib only); monai/data/__init__.py gained an explicit export line; docs/source/data.rst gained a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with one autofunction entry under Utilities; tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py has TestLoadDecathalonDatalist with test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, and test_seg_no_labels, each cleaning up its temp directory in a finally block. Nothing was run or installed, per instructions; I only checked that no new line exceeds 120 columns. Judgment calls: absent image/label fields are skipped rather than raised on; a non-list data_list_key value raises ValueError; JSON parse errors surface as json.JSONDecodeError (a ValueError subclass); files are opened as UTF-8. Nothing was committed.
